metaTitle: Clinic & Hospital Management Software in Odisha | Lucoze
metaDescription: Lucoze runs records, appointments, GST billing, lab & pharmacy for clinics in Bhubaneswar, Cuttack, Rourkela & Berhampur. ABDM-ready, DPDP-compliant, data in India.
h1Parts: , built to run the front desk.
lead: One platform for patient records, appointments, GST billing, lab and pharmacy — made for the way clinics in Odisha actually work. Records, ABHA and billing from the first visit.
intro: Odisha's health scene is growing fast — the Bhubaneswar–Cuttack corridor keeps adding new hospitals, specialty clinics and diagnostic centres, and patients travel in from Berhampur, Sambalpur, Puri and beyond. Lucoze puts patient records, appointments, GST-ready billing, lab reports and pharmacy stock on one platform, so the front desk stops juggling registers, Excel sheets and three apps. You can create an ABHA at the first visit, keep records clean for BSKY and insurance claims, and pull a patient's history in seconds — whether they came in last week or last year from another district.
points: Records, appointments, GST billing, lab and pharmacy in one place — no more stitching together a booking app, a billing tool and a pile of registers.
Create or link a patient's ABHA number during registration and keep your practice ABDM-ready as Odisha's digital health push rolls out.
Keep documentation tidy for Biju Swasthya Kalyan Yojana (BSKY), Ayushman Bharat (PMJAY) and private insurance so claims don't bounce back over missing paperwork.
All patient data sits in Indian data centres under DPDP 2023, and there's no lock-in — export to CSV or PDF whenever you want.
localContext: Front desks across Odisha run in Odia first, with Hindi and English in the bigger city hospitals — a receptionist in Saheed Nagar or a diagnostic centre in Cuttack's Buxi Bazaar shouldn't have to fight the software to register a walk-in. Lucoze's patient search already handles Odia, Devanagari and Latin spellings, so 'Subrata', 'ସୁବ୍ରତ' or a phone number all pull up the same file. The interface itself is rolling out in Hindi first (Q3 2026), then Bengali, then Odia — Odia UI is on the roadmap, not shipped yet — so for now we hand your team printable Odia cheat-sheets. Support is remote-first from our team in Konnagar, Hooghly, with on-site help for larger hospital deployments.

faqs.a: Not yet — we're honest about this. The interface rolls out in Hindi first (Q3 2026), then Bengali, then Odia, which is on the roadmap. What works today: multilingual patient search across Odia, Devanagari and Latin spellings, plus printable Odia cheat-sheets for your front desk while the full Odia UI is built.

faqs.q: Do you offer setup support in Odisha?
faqs.a: Our team is based in Konnagar, Hooghly (West Bengal), so support for Odisha is remote-first: video onboarding, hands-on data migration from your old registers or Excel, WhatsApp and chat support, and printable Odia cheat-sheets. For larger hospital deployments we can arrange on-site help — just ask.

faqs.q: Where is our patient data stored?
faqs.a: In Indian data centres, handled under the Digital Personal Data Protection Act 2023. There's no lock-in either — you can export your records to CSV or PDF any time, so the data is always yours to take with you.
